expected_value_creation: QIF users can deterministically detect policy-state drift and preserve a human-governed emergency demotion record before relying on stale trust decisions.
beneficiary: Human, AI, and hybrid organizations applying portable QIF knowledge
supporting_evidence: NIST, Microsoft, Google Cloud, and AWS guidance converges on continuous monitoring, drift signals, accountable ownership, incident response, recovery, and retirement.
success_criteria: Every drift assessment reproduces from a frozen approved baseline and an evidence-backed observation.
Material or unverified drift triggers governance and blocks continued promoted status.
Emergency demotion requires explicit authority, scope, target policy, evidence, deadline, and post-action reconciliation.
